Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Work directly with clients. Seek to understand. Be an expert on our platform. Know where to configure vs build to close a gap. Own the build and delivery of the outcome. See it through from end to end.

We’re building a small team in New York to close the gap between the needs of our clients and delivering their needs.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a coordination role. You’ll have the ownership and responsibilities of a software engineer, alongside ownership of a client relationship. You have the ability to work confidently with clients and guide them through unfamiliar territory. That means leading discovery sessions, asking open questions and seeking to understand. You will build a deep platform knowledge in order to make sound technical decisions, build and ship those solutions, triage and fix issues and following through to make sure it delivered the outcome the client needed. You own this from end to end.

Expect a high pace environment, evolving approaches and problems without solutions. We’re looking for people who enjoy ambiguity and making progress in that environment.



🚀 What you’ll own:

 - Build client relationships. You will understand how clients actually work, working directly with operational teams and stakeholders to uncover friction, question assumptions and distinguish symptoms from root causes.

 - Lead the client conversation. Build trust, demonstrate ideas early and challenge requests constructively. Help clients adopt Kraken’s capabilities and ways of working, recognising when changing a process is a better answer than building custom software.

 - Turn unclear problems into buildable solutions. Investigate workflows, systems and data. Develop options, explain trade-offs and establish a practical path forward.

 - Build and ship. Start with Kraken’s existing capabilities and configuration, and design, implement, test and release production software where changes are needed. Build solutions that fit the platform rather than create unnecessary client-specific complexity.

 - Work agent-first. Use agents as a core part of investigation, development and testing. Give them useful context, direct their work and critically assess the results. You remain accountable for what ships.

 - Own the outcome beyond deployment. Make sure the solution works in practice, support adoption and verify that it addresses the original problem.

 - Work across Kraken. Partner with client engineering, delivery and product teams to decide whether a problem is best addressed through existing capabilities, a targeted change or the broader product roadmap. Bring in specialist expertise and balance immediate client needs with the long-term direction of the platform.

 - Extend the impact. Recognise when a solution can benefit other clients, and help turn successful approaches into reusable capabilities and ways of working.



🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

 - Strong software engineering experience. You’ve independently delivered and maintained production software, and can navigate unfamiliar codebases, review changes and make sound technical decisions.

 - Demonstrated client-facing skills. You’ve worked directly with clients, led discovery or solution discussions, and explained technical choices to both engineering and non-technical audiences.

 - Practical problem-solving ability. You can take a messy operational problem, investigate what matters and build an effective solution without waiting for a complete specification.

 - An agent-first approach to building. You can use coding agents and AI-enabled tools effectively while applying your own engineering judgement to their outputs.

 - Ownership and follow-through. You take responsibility for whether your work solves the problem, not just whether the code is merged.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You make progress with incomplete information, test assumptions early and know when to move quickly or investigate further.

 - A collaborative engineering mindset. You work constructively with existing teams and build solutions others can understand, operate and maintain.

 - Patience and an ability to explain complex things in a simple way.

The focus of this team

Its focus is significant operational problems where investigation, inventive thinking and hands-on engineering can unlock meaningful improvements. You may work across different workstreams as priorities evolve. Owning the solution does not mean doing everything yourself, but it does mean staying accountable through to a working result.

Bonus points:

We'd be particularly excited if you bring one or more of the following:

 - Experience in energy, utilities, or billing and switching in regulated markets.

 - Experience with incident response or on-call for production systems.

 - A prior forward deployed engineer or customer-facing engineering role.

 - A track record of building internal tools or integrations that teams adopted.

 - Evidence of cutting handoffs or rework in a delivery process.



⭐️ Why you'll love it here: 

 - Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

 - Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

 - 401(k) plan with employer match.

 - Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible.

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits.

 - Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance.

 - Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

 - Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

**Flight Simulation Software Engineer**

**Remote, Nationwide**

Our client is an established aviation technology company building sophisticated professional flight simulation systems for a highly advanced segment of general aviation. This is an opportunity to take a meaningful role in a simulation platform where avionics behavior, navigation logic, detailed mapping, and cockpit displays must work together with a high degree of realism. The company combines the resources and market presence of an established simulation provider with the visibility and influence of a smaller engineering team. For the right engineer, this is a chance to own challenging technical problems, shape a growing software platform, and make an impact that is easy to see.

**This Role Offers**

* Opportunity to solve technically demanding problems involving flight management, navigation, mapping, cockpit visualization, and real time simulation.
* Long term product roadmap with continued investment in new capabilities, stability, and realism.
* Collaborative environment with experienced aviation and simulation professionals.
* Opportunity to work across the software stack, with particular value placed on engineers who can contribute to both core C++ systems and user facing applications.
* Flexible compensation based on depth of avionics knowledge, software capabilities, and overall technical fit.

**Focus**

* Develop and refine software that models sophisticated aircraft navigation and flight management behavior within a professional simulation platform.
* Translate ARINC 424 navigation data and procedure definitions into reliable runtime logic for routing, approaches, departures, arrivals, holds, and other flight path behaviors.
* Implement accurate FMS functionality, including waypoint sequencing, leg transitions, course calculations, turn behavior, and holding logic.
* Build and maintain modern C++ components responsible for real time simulation, telemetry, networking, and avionics state management.
* Connect simulation software with X-Plane, working with DataRefs, commands, SDK functionality, and real time data exchange.
* Contribute to desktop interfaces using JavaScript, Node.js, and Electron for cockpit displays, navigation maps, and other visualization features.
* Develop software models for interconnected avionics components and support communication across simulated data bus and network environments.
* Create and enhance moving map, airport visualization, and synthetic vision capabilities that reproduce complex flight deck behavior.
* Partner with a compact engineering team to integrate backend simulation logic with frontend displays, troubleshoot system behavior, and improve overall platform stability.
* Help expand a mature simulation product through new features, architectural improvements, testing, and ongoing performance enhancements.

**Skill Set**

* Strong professional experience developing software in modern C++, particularly for real time, simulation, embedded, networking, or similarly complex systems.
* Deep working knowledge of aircraft avionics and Flight Management Systems is required.
* Hands on understanding of ARINC 424 navigation data, procedure structures, and common FMS leg types.
* Strong knowledge of aviation navigation concepts, including instrument procedures and radio or satellite based navigation systems.
* Experience working with X-Plane, ideally including DataRefs, commands, plugins, SDK integrations, or other programmatic interfaces.
* Ability to translate real world avionics behavior and flight procedures into accurate software logic.
* Experience with JavaScript, Node.js, or Electron is highly valuable for engineers interested in contributing across the full stack.
* Understanding of network communication, data buses, or distributed software components used to exchange real time system state.
* Experience with graphical mapping, synthetic vision, OpenGL, WebGL, Canvas, or related visualization technologies is a plus.
* Familiarity with advanced integrated flight decks or technically sophisticated general aviation aircraft is highly desirable.
* Pilot experience, including a Private Pilot License or Instrument Rating, is beneficial but not required.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work independently within a distributed engineering team.
* Comfortable taking ownership of technically complex problems in an environment where aviation knowledge is just as important as software expertise.
